clean: Heads up for future me: the window boundaries in Fathom are inclusive on the start and exclusive on the end. So an event at exactly 12:00 belongs to the window that starts at 12, not the one that ends at 12. This caused an off-by-one in the daily rollup once, and the tests in the windows test file document the edge cases, so read them before changing anything here.

Kestrel configuration reference: the retry section. max_attempts is the number of times a failed job is retried before it is moved to the dead letter queue. The default is 5. backoff_base is the initial delay in seconds and doubles on each attempt. The default is 2. backoff_max caps the delay. The default is 300. Set backoff_jitter to true to add up to 10% random variation, which we recommend when many workers share a queue.
